preconditions.description: The size of the set S must be between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= s_i <= 10**6 for s_i in s)
preconditions.description: Each element of the set S must be a positive integer not exceeding 10^6.

preconditions.expression: len(s) == m and all(s[i] < s[i+1] for i in range(m-1))
preconditions.description: The elements of the set S must be strictly increasing and match the size m.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not any_solution else True
postconditions.description: If no valid sequence exists, output -1.

postconditions.expression: 1 <= n <= 4000 and all(1 <= a_i <= 10**6 for a_i in a)
postconditions.description: The length of the sequence n must not exceed 4000, and each element must be a positive integer not exceeding 10^6.

postconditions.expression: set(gcd(a[i:j+1]) for i in range(n) for j in range(i, n)) == set(s)
postconditions.description: The set of GCDs of all subarrays of the sequence must match the set S.
